problem: N.E.K.O can queue both a newly dispatched commission and a commission being taken up again. New dispatch content is durable in the commission row, but TaskAgentManager._requeue stores the take-up continuation only in the in-memory _resume map after transitioning to queued. A host death therefore cannot safely distinguish/reconstruct every old queued commission.

authority_boundary.effect: N.E.K.O host_calls + existing managed idempotency/receipt semantics

reuse_search.L0_authority: Keep commission/session/queue authority in N.E.K.O; persist only the otherwise-volatile take-up text in the existing event log.

reusable: TaskAgentManager._start_next starts queued work using _resume when present
L1_neko_current_pin.gap: _requeue transitions to queued before writing continuation only to in-memory _resume; Ledger._reconcile then fails every old queued commission.

L2_neko_upstream_extensions.result: No equivalent durable requeue-continuation/startup queue reconstruction seam observed; restart policy remains fail-old-active.

reuse_search.L3_native_adjacent: Use existing task-agent queue/start/session lookup only; do not add a scheduler.
reuse_search.L4_external: External workflow engines/reliable queues are rejected because they would duplicate the frozen commission/session authority.
reuse_search.L5_thin_integration: Selected candidate: append a durable queue-resume event before the queued transition, preserve prior-host task-agent queued rows, rebuild only those rows through _know_session + the existing _queue/_start_next path.

safety_rules: Durable continuation event must commit before transition to queued; an orphan event is harmless when transition later fails.
Recovery considers only current task_agent queued commissions; terminal/cancelled rows are never revived.
Initial queued commissions with no take-up continuation use their native commission opening message exactly as normal initial queueing.
Requeued commissions restore only the latest durable continuation for the current queued state.
No prior-host working commission is recovered by this unit.
No host_call status grants permission or authorizes replay; effects remain governed by current permission/idempotency/receipt semantics.
Session identity is read from native Ledger; no new session identifier is minted.
retirement_condition: Delete when upstream N.E.K.O durably reconstructs both initial and take-up queued task-agent work after host restart without losing continuation text or replaying active effects.
